Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk & Fraud
Company: PaySafe India is a leading Indian fintech company (Mumbai, Maharashtra) providing digital payments, UPI infrastructure, and consumer credit products to 60M+ users, processing over INR 5 lakh crore in annual transaction value.

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra (Hybrid - 2 days/week on-site at BKC office)
Compensation: INR 30-45 LPA + performance bonus + ESOPs

About the Role:
We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to lead modeling efforts for our credit underwriting and transaction fraud detection systems. You will own end-to-end model development and deployment, interface directly with the risk and compliance functions, and ensure our models remain fair, explainable, and regulatory-compliant under RBI guidelines.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain credit scoring models (scorecard, logistic regression, gradient boosting) for personal loans and BNPL products
- Build real-time fraud detection models processing millions of UPI and card transactions daily
- Conduct feature engineering from payments data, bureau data, and behavioural signals to improve model discrimination
- Prepare and present model documentation for internal model risk review and regulatory submissions
- Monitor model performance, population stability, and concept drift; own model re-training schedules
- Mentor junior data scientists and establish data science standards within the risk analytics team

Requirements:
- 5+ years of data science experience, with at least 3 years in financial services (credit or fraud) (required)
- Expert-level Python skills for statistical modeling and ML (required)
- Strong SQL skills for data extraction from large transactional datasets (required)
- Experience with statistical modeling for credit: logistic regression, scorecard development, survival models (required)
- Familiarity with UPI, payments ecosystem, and India-specific credit bureau data (CIBIL, Experian) (required)
- Understanding of RBI regulations relevant to digital lending and model risk (required)

Nice to have:
- Experience with graph-based fraud detection or network analysis
- Knowledge of explainability tools (SHAP, LIME) for regulatory-compliant model interpretation
- Familiarity with Apache Spark for large-scale transaction feature engineering
- Experience presenting to risk committees or regulatory bodies
- Prior work experience at a leading Indian fintech (Paytm, PhonePe, Razorpay, CRED, etc.)
